prompts.title: 建筑事务所
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a sophisticated, production-credible art-directed desktop application design study for 疯狂办公室, an interactive multi-agent office network topology. The input screenshot is a FUNCTIONAL CONTENT reference only; completely redesign the visual language, illustration and interface. Retain room types, a real working office/network map, tiny adults working at computer desks, servers and network equipment, investment department with general office to its RIGHT, conference room, finance, reception, business management. The whole main view is the office; NO top navigation bar, no dashboard grid. Only a small bottom actions strip. This is an application screenshot, not a landing page or promotional presentation.
Produce ONE landscape high-resolution design board, 2560x1600-like composition: left 72% is a complete widescreen office application main view with intelligent quiet typography; right 28% is a clean vertical column of two enlarged interaction states from the SAME design, upper an employee-to-employee handoff, lower a human approval dialog. Separate these three views with generous whitespace, not decorative frames. The main office must be spacious and architecturally coherent, with legible rooms and interesting well-drawn furniture/people. Do not overcrowd or leave a vacant map.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: absolutely NO cast shadows, drop shadows, box shadows, ambient-occlusion shadows, glow, frosted glass, gradient buttons, single-edge accent borders, decorative vertical stripes, double framing, floating wire cages, avatar frames, hexagonal platforms, halos, or transparent/ghost workers. Use flat solid surfaces and restrained precise structural contours. All characters fully opaque. Distinguish virtual and real employees by their CHARACTER DESIGN: virtual colleagues are tasteful humanlike assistants wearing a consistent digital work uniform with small ceramic-white articulated wrist/ear components and a discreet two-square insignia; real colleagues have natural skin, individual hair and mature casual business clothes. Both look equally present and seated correctly at monitors. No robot emoji or stereotypical cartoon robot heads; no huge floating namecards. Show tiny bare names only where necessary; selected employee alone may show one concise contextual panel. People about 1:5 head/body stylized mature proportions, not infant chibis.
Right-upper interaction: two full-bodied colleagues exchange a plain file tablet; a concise action sheet containing exactly "报价审查", "小张 → 周助理", "配置核对已交付", one small solid button "查看文件". Right-lower interaction: refined plain opaque approval dialog with exact readable Chinese text "请你审批", "服务器采购申请", "技术审查与预算核对已完成", two file rows "技术核对.pdf" and "预算依据.xlsx", buttons "退回" and "同意方案". Consistent excellent Chinese typography, thoughtful spacing, no filler prose, no marketing words, no fake huge metrics. Main room labels: "投资者关系部", "总经办", "开放办公区", "网络机房", "业务管理室", "会议室", "客户会见厅", "财务办公室". Bottom actions exactly "员工", "任务", "记录", "文件", "全屏". Small main activity label "采购调研 · 审查中". Minimal crisp UI text, no meaningless English subtitles on every room. The intended quality is outstanding contemporary independent software / editorial architecture illustration, coherent, expensive-looking, personal, not generic AI SaaS template.
ART DIRECTION A — 建筑事务所. A beautifully composed bright architectural editorial plan. Warm ivory matte canvas, ink-black text, subtle neutral stone-gray architectural floor zones, a single precise cobalt-blue accent used for active task routes and virtual work uniforms. Orthographic top-down/very slight axonometric furniture, sophisticated clean thin line illustration, furniture has clear geometric detail without ornamental shading, natural hair/skin, tailored human clothing. Main office uses elegant open partitions and negative space, intentional asymmetrical composition. The room architecture is clear and modern; a subtle floorplan not blueprint grid. Blue paths only for current collaborative route, other network connections hairline gray and limited. Main action strip is a compact flat black rectangular bar with 12px corner radius, no shadow. Dialog backgrounds warm-white, dark type, cobalt filled primary action. Small caption above board "建筑事务所" with a tiny "A" and nothing else.
